pages.title: Overview
pages.text: The Iron Gollet is a small guardian with 25 health. It attacks hostile creatures except Creepers and deals between 7.5 and 21.5 damage.$(br2)Gollets prioritize injured Villagers, carry them away from nearby threats, and grant Regeneration II. They release a Villager when fully healed or after a short rescue period.

pages.name: Iron Gollet
pages.text: They defend Villagers, Iron Golems, and other village-linked Gollets when those protectors are attacked.

pages.title: Creation
pages.text: Place a Carved Pumpkin directly on top of one Iron Block, then right-click the Pumpkin with a Poppy. The two blocks and the Poppy are consumed, and the new Gollet belongs to the player who created it.

pages.title: Carrying the Owner
pages.text: Only a player-created Gollet can carry its owner. Right-click your Gollet to mount it and receive Regeneration II while carried. Press Shift to dismount.$(br2)A village-linked Gollet cannot carry a player.
